## 席位核对 — ACCEPT (L1-b)

Head-sha: b5445c21 · read 2026-11-21T13:02Z · 18 files +95/−33 · base main 8145424b · checks at this head: 45 success · 13 expected skip · 0 failed · 0 pending · mergeable clean · l1-face CLEAN · merges pairwise clean with #36024, #36033 and #36042, the other open PRs that touch the same grid

**维护者速读：** 列表表格的观感调整：列与列之间加了一条和横线一样浅的竖线；默认行高和表头从 32 变成 36；底部统计行里没设统计的格子一直显示浅色的「+ 添加统计」，不用先把鼠标移上去才知道能点。只改样子，不动数据；没有权限改视图的人仍然看不到「添加统计」。有一处没量过：表格有冻结列、横向滚动时，竖线可能从冻结列上面划过去（浏览器对这种表格边框的画法有已知问题）。建议找一个有冻结列的列表看一眼，有问题再换画法；不阻塞。

### Must-fix
None.

### Should-fix

**S1 — measure a frozen column scrolled sideways before calling the line done.** The column line is a real `border-r` on every `th`/`td` but the last. The table is in the collapsed border model: Tailwind's preflight sets `border-collapse: collapse` on `table`, and `ui/table.tsx` sets no `border-separate`. In that model the browser paints cell borders as the table's, not the cell's. With a sticky frozen column (`isFrozen && 'sticky z-10 bg-background'`), two things can go wrong as the rows scroll under it. The frozen cell's own right line can stay at its original position, and the vertical lines of the scrolling columns can paint over the frozen cell's background. The body says this was not measured, because 客户 has no frozen column. One reading in Chromium (and in Safari if anyone can) of a list with a frozen column, scrolled sideways, settles it. If the lines do bleed, drawing them as an inset `box-shadow` (or an `::after`) on the cell instead of a border keeps them on the cell and leaves the scroll shadow alone. The row lines are `border-b` on the `tr` and were already there, so they do not change.

### Nits
- N1 — `compact` and `short` now share `h-9` and differ only by leading. That is intended, and the boundary test keeps them as separate copies. Since the row-height menu offers Compact, Standard and Spacious, `short` is reachable only from authored `rowHeight: 'short'`. Nothing to change, but such a view now looks almost the same as a default one.

### Checked
- `OBJECT_GRID_TABLE_DENSITY`: `[&_th:not(:last-child)]` and `[&_td:not(:last-child)]` give a 1px right border in `border-border/50` (the row lines' shade). The header goes to `h-9`. A group header row (one `td` with `colSpan`) is its row's last child and draws no line. The e2e spec reads the computed width, style and colour off header, body (lead checkbox cell included) and footer cells against the row line, and 0px on each last cell. The ablation (line entry removed, that case goes red) is in the body.
- Row height: the `compact` arm goes from `h-8` to `h-9`. The e2e pins header 36 and rows 36 against compiled Tailwind on the real class sources. The footer row is unchanged.
- `SummaryCellPicker`: the empty-cell hint is drawn at rest (`text-muted-foreground/70`, a `Plus`, darker on hover or focus-visible) only on the `onPick` branch. A reader without it still sees nothing in an empty footer cell (pinned in `footerCalculationPicker-35702`). The menu wiring is untouched, so the #35933 read-only-package gate still applies.
- `grid.summary.calculate` changes its value in all 11 packs and in the plugin's English default. No key is added or removed, so `Clause-②: no` holds. The key is read only by `objectGridSummaryPicker.tsx` (grep), as the hint and as the button's `aria-label` on an empty cell, so the accessible name changes with it.
- The e2e spec is also touched by #36024, which re-anchors `switcherBody`. The two edits sit in different blocks and merge cleanly.
- Shape: `Fixes #36048`, one changeset (plugin-grid and i18n, patch), `Metadata-protocol: none`.

### Owed
- The S1 reading (author or seat). The L1 is final at this head otherwise. To the seat for landing.

## 席位核对 — delta ACCEPT (L1-b)

Head-sha: 0a1f7470 (one commit on b5445c21, 2 files +24/−9) · read 2026-11-21T13:36Z · prior record ACCEPT 7062990450 · CI at this head: 47 success · 15 expected skip · 0 failed, mergeable clean (per the thread)

**维护者速读：** 上次提的冻结列问题量过了，确实有：横向滚动时冻结列的竖线会消失。现在竖线改用“内阴影”画在格子自己身上，冻结列滚动时线一直在，和原来的滚动阴影能同时显示。其他位置看起来不变。无新问题。

### S1 — resolved
- The thread's reading at b5445c21 confirmed half of the risk. With `border-r`, the frozen columns lost their lines when scrolled sideways. The scrolling columns' lines did not paint over the frozen cells.
- At 0a1f7470 the line is `inset-shadow-[-1px_0_0_0]` with `inset-shadow-border/50` on `th`/`td:not(:last-child)`. Tailwind v4 puts that in its own `--tw-inset-shadow` slot of the composed `box-shadow`. The frozen edge's `FROZEN_EDGE_SHADOW` (`shadow-[…]`, class-based, `data-table.tsx:1032`) and an error cell's `ring-2 ring-inset` sit in other slots of the same stack, so they add to the line rather than replace it. No cell sets an inline `boxShadow` that would override it (grep across `data-table.tsx` and `ObjectGrid.tsx`). The thread's computed reading shows the name edge carrying the inset line and the frozen shadow together, in light and dark.
- e2e: the compile input now defines `--color-border`, so the colour equality compares real colours. At b5445c21 both sides were the unset value, so that assertion could not fail. The case now reads exactly one inset layer, offsets `-1px 0px 0px 0px`, the row line's colour, `borderRight` 0px, and no inset layer on each last cell. The ablation for this head is in the note.
- Docblock: it says why the line is a shadow (collapsed borders belong to the table).

### Nits
- None new. A child that paints its own full-cell background (an open in-cell editor's layer) will cover the line while it is open. That is expected and the same as the row lines.

### Owed
- L1 final at this head. To the seat for landing.
